trial_court: Court of Judicial Magistrate First Class-02, North West District, Rohini Courts, Delhi (Ct. Case 6541/2016)

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Ms. Laxmi Devi, wife of Sh. Ravinder Kumar Saini
parties.respondent_defendant: Krishna Devi, wife of Sh. Mahender

facts_of_case: The complainant lent the accused Rs. 2,50,000 in cash against a written receipt. The accused issued three cheques to the complainant, but one cheque was returned unpaid. The complainant presented the cheque and sent legal demand notices, but the accused failed to pay within 15 days.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the accused to prove her defence.
legal_principles.held: She reiterated her innocence and opted to lead defence evidence.

legal_principles.principle: A person's signature and thumb impression can be used as evidence.
legal_principles.held: She correctly identified her signature at point A and B on Ex. CW1/1 however she denied the thumb impression on point A and B

outcome.final_order: The accused is convicted of the offence under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881.

use_for_drafting: drafting a complaint under section 138 NI Act
preparing a defence against cheque bounce charges
